title: Page history
auth: Sign in and verify your email address.
denied: History is unavailable. Check your current account, page management permission and connection.
retention: Saved title and document snapshots. The workspace retains up to 32 snapshots and 300,000 bytes; older snapshots are pruned. This is not a full backup.
consent: Replace the current title and document with the reviewed snapshot.
scope: Permissions, attachment binaries, table cells and page location are not restored. Unsaved changes in other tabs will conflict after restoration.
restored: Restored as a new saved version.
uncertain: The result is unknown. Your review state is retained. Reload to check the current version.
conflict: Another change exists. Reload the current version and review again.
source: Source content is displayed as literal text.
localeFallbackNotice: Some labels use English. Page names and content are not translated.
